schedules_note: Built-in full 24h price schedules keyed by supercharge.info site id. bands: [startHour, endHour, $/kWh] on a 24h clock (end exclusive; may wrap past midnight, e.g. [22,6,0.2]). Every hour should be covered. Optional: congestion_fee_per_min, entered, source. Takes priority over history-derived off-peak bands; localStorage prices still override. Optional 'open': [startHour,endHour] = site opening hours (24h clock, fractional ok e.g. 4.5, end exclusive, may wrap); the planner never schedules a stop whose arrival-to-departure window falls outside it. Optional 'guess_bands': [[start,end,$/kWh]] = hours with an assumed (unconfirmed) price, treated as an estimate with the usual guessed-price penalty.
